summary: Order (mode 50) and trade (mode 51) packets on the market data socket: the desktop relays each as an order_update with OpenAlgo's constants (open, partly filled, complete, a trade fill, rejected with its reason, cancelled); the web's market adapter ignores both modes and the web has no Pocketful order feed.

notes: The web decodes these packets (packet_decoder.py:279-302, after a 5-byte prefix) but _on_message dispatches modes 1, 2 and 4 only (pocketful_adapter.py:546-551), and order_update_service.py:36-79 has no Pocketful factory, so no order update reaches a web client.

The JSON field names follow Pocketful's order book (oms_order_id, order_status, trading_symbol, ...), as brokers/pocketful/streaming.rs::PocketfulFeed::order_update reads them; the live packet layout is unverified.

deviations.reason: Pocketful sends order and trade updates on the market data socket (modes 50 and 51, which the web's own packet_decoder.py decodes) and the web drops them, so a web client never hears an order change; the desktop relays them as order_update frames (an extension the audit records, RB-14).
